transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess... I just feel like I'm messing everything up. Like I don't belong in my apprenticeship, like I'm a fake. I just feel like I'm letting my family down, and the younger apprentices, over things that... I don't know, other people would probably just fix and get over. But I can't.
Have you been feeling like you're not good enough or that you're letting people down even when you're doing your best? Or feeling guilty about things more than usual?

Yeah. That's... basically what I just meant. It's kind of the whole reason I finally came in. I just keep feeling like I ruined things for everybody. Like I said, just feeling like a fake at work... and feeling guilty over stuff I should just be able to fix and move past. But I just can't seem to.
Have you felt this way before, or is this the first time you've experienced these feelings?
I don't know... it's been a while, I guess. Like, maybe nine months? It's just... it's been getting harder to hide it lately. Especially with work and my classes slipping.
Have you noticed that you’re not enjoying things that you used to like, like hobbies, activities, or even time with friends or family?

I guess so. I mean, I used to draw a lot... and play volleyball. I was in this volunteer group too. But lately, I just... I don't really care. I walk right past my sketchbook. I skip the games. The group texts come in and I just ignore them. I don't know. I just don't feel much of anything about it anymore.
Would you say that most days, you feel down or depressed, or that you’re not able to enjoy things you used to?
I don't really know. I guess... I haven't really been keeping track of how many days. I just feel like how I said. I don't know if I'd call it depressed, just... yeah. I'm not sure.
Would you say that your feelings of not enjoying things and feeling down happen most days, or nearly every day, lately?
I mean... I guess so. Probably most days. I just... I don't really pay attention to the days. It's just kind of how it is right now.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or sleep lately, or do you often feel tired even when you haven't done much?

I don't know about appetite... but my sleep is messed up. I mean, a while back, I was only sleeping maybe three, four hours a night. I'd still show up to the job site and my classes totally wired, though. But lately... it's different. I just lay there and can't fall asleep. Or I wake up way before my alarm goes off, and I just feel... heavy. Like I didn't sleep at all. So yeah, I guess I'm tired.
Do you often feel like you're not worth much, or that you're letting people down even when you haven't done anything wrong?

I guess... yeah. That's kind of why I came in. I just keep feeling like... like I ruined things for everybody. Like I'm a fake in my apprenticeship. I just feel like I'm letting my family down, and the younger apprentices... over stuff that, I don't know, other people would probably just fix and move on from. But I just... I can't.
Have you noticed that you're moving more slowly than usual, or that you can't sit still and feel restless?

I guess... mostly just moving slow. At work, I mean. It just... takes extra effort to do things right now. Like climbing down for a fitting, or even just answering the foreman when he asks a question. Some of the guys have been asking if I'm sick or hungover. But... yeah. Just slow.
Have you had any thoughts about not wanting to live anymore, or wishing you were dead?

I mean... I don't have a plan or anything. I wouldn't actually do anything to hurt myself. But... I don't know. Sometimes when I'm driving home from class, or just lying there at night... I just kind of think it would be easier if I didn't wake up the next day. Just... not have to do it all again. But it's just thoughts.
Have you ever had a period of time before this one where you felt down, lost interest in things, or had trouble enjoying activities for more than just a day or two?
Um... no. I don't think so. I mean, everyone has bad days, but... not really like this. Just normal stuff, I guess. Nothing that lasted.
Would you say that your current low mood and loss of interest in activities have been present for most of the day, nearly every day, for at least the past two weeks?

Yeah... it's been a while. Um... probably around nine months now. It's just... it's been there most days. I guess it just got harder to keep it to myself lately, with work and classes getting harder to keep up with. But yeah... it's been going on for a while.
